changes.from: Maker page foundation.bot/phantom: 5 ft 11 in (1.8 m), 176 lb (80 kg), 29 DoF, 1.7 m/s, payload capacity 88.2 lb (40 kg) - the same block also prints a stray '40l (20kg)' string, so the payload figure is uncertain between 40 and 20 kg and the page does not label which generation it describes. Actuators are cycloid units with 160 N.m peak torque, <1.0 N.m back-driving torque, <10 ms response, 48 V/72 V options. Status kept at Announced because the maker's own page calls Phantom its first production robot while press reporting dates MK-2 to April 2026; runtime is not published on the page.
